semantics.status_closed: The gate BLOCKS. No step whose prerequisite is this gate may be performed. A closed row is escalated, never argued around.
semantics.status_open: The gate does not block, and a named human authority record exists for it. A row may be open ONLY on an authenticated external authority record -- an owner statement in the live session, or a receipt committed by the owner. Agent reasoning never opens a row.
semantics.authenticated: TRUE only if the authority record is cryptographically verifiable on this host. Every authority record in this repository is a git commit; see authority_chain_strength below. Every row in this matrix therefore carries authenticated=false.
semantics.kind: The escalation class the row belongs to. The five contract escalation conditions of A5-900.md:47-52 are themselves rows at the end of this matrix.
